findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vadyu_get_video_status · Private data: vadyu_preview_storefront, vadyu_list_recipes, vadyu_list_sequences_and_formats · Public sink: vadyu_get_video_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: vadyu_get_video_status · Private data: vadyu_preview_storefront, vadyu_list_recipes, vadyu_list_sequences_and_formats · Public sink: vadyu_get_video_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "vadyu_generate_video_ad" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Generate a commercial multi-cut AI video ad (with precision product cutout, live-action 3D studio lighting, golden-hour lifestyle scene, and AI studio voiceover) from a product_url, image_url, image_base64, or 0-credit reuse_video_id." → after: "Render a multi-cut AI commercial video ad (3D studio lighting, lifestyle scene, and voiceover) from a URL, image, or reuse_video_id."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
